subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers revive the linked cross-repo fix PR, or replace it with a fresh focused main-branch fix that also covers the current transcript/model prompt split?
rationale: The issue is valid and documented, but the open linked PR is stale, conflicting, and appears to target only part of the current prompt path, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing route.

options.title: Replace with fresh focused fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale linked PR and land a narrow current-main fix covering both custom prompt mutation and model-visible prompt selection.

options.title: Revive linked PR
options.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to rebase the linked PR, add real behavior proof, and expand it if needed for the current prompt split.

options.title: Hold for owner review
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair work until the heartbeat area owner decides the prompt/transcript policy.

recommendation.title: Replace with fresh focused fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale linked PR and land a narrow current-main fix covering both custom prompt mutation and model-visible prompt selection.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the regression-provenance commit and also appears in the linked duplicate fix history, making them the clearest first routing candidate.
